title: Uniform Encoder
text: Quantize and encode floating-point input into integer output, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough; {Peak} sets the largest input amplitude to encode, {Bits} sets the number of bits and {Output type} sets the data type of block output. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Peak
params.values: Largest input amplitude to encode 1 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Bits
params.values: Number of bits 8 (default) | integer in the range [ 2, 32 ]

params.name: Output type
params.values: Data type of block output Unsigned integer (default) | Signed integer
